title: Language
content:
While playing ''Genshin Impact'', players can find many different '''languages''' and '''scripts''' while exploring Teyvat, most of which are based on real-world languages. This article covers scripts which players can see while playing the game and is not necessarily comprehensive of all languages which exist in the world of Teyvat.

Aside from Hilichurlian and Ishine Script, all language names are unofficial.

title: Sub-Space Creation
content:
'''Sub-Space Creation''' or '''Waijing'''  is an adeptal ability used to create small, autonomous pocket worlds through imagination. This technique can also be used to create larger abodes, such as the Realm of Clouds and the Sea Gazer's Abode.

This ability was a blessing from Rex Lapis and has been used during troubling times for some brief respite. Even though it is a powerful adeptal ability, it does have certain limitations: one cannot build a whole city inside the Serenitea Pot, since it is not a true world.

title: Seven Mountain Treatises
content: The '''Seven Mountain Treatises''' is a document first mentioned by Baizhu in the . Based on current descriptions and references to it, it appears to be some sort of natural history document.

title: Heroes of Natlan
content: The '''Heroes of Natlan''' are a group of Ancient Name bearers who were specially chosen to lead Natlan in battle against the Abyss. The original six Heroes were the companions of Xbalanque who joined him in his war against Xiuhcoatl. During the cataclysm, one from each tribe were selected by Tenoch, while another six were rallied in the present day. Certain other individuals, due to their importance in the plan to defeat the Abyss, are also referred to as Heroes of Natlan.

title: Prophecy of Fontaine
content:
The '''prophecy of Fontaine''' ''(unofficial name)'', referred to in-game simply as '''the prophecy''', is an apocalyptic prophecy that is believed to have been foretold by Egeria, the former Hydro Archon. However, it is speculated by the Traveler that the prophecy may have actually been divined by Vedrfolnir, the Visionary.

According to the prophecy, all inhabitants of Fontaine are born with sin that cannot be absolved. The prophecy also states that one day, the water levels in Fontaine will rise, and all individuals with sin will be drowned and dissolved, with only the Hydro Archon remaining, weeping on her throne. The prophecy further predicts that during this great flood, the sins of the people of Fontaine will be washed away.

title: The Crux Clash
content:
'''The Crux Clash''' is a reoccurring martial arts tournament organized by Beidou of the Crux Fleet to uncover hidden talents in Liyue.

The tournament is in a single-elimination format. While Beidou requires participants to be renowned and have no Vision, most of them are generally show-offs who have little to no combat prowess.

During the , the grand prize of the tournament is a Masterless Vision provided by Kazuha. After speaking with the Traveler and learning of their desire to go to Inazuma, Beidou changed the grand prize for them to a choice of the Masterless Vision or a ticket to Inazuma aboard the Alcor.

title: Armory Palace
content: The '''Royal Armory Palace''', usually simply called the '''Armory Palace''', is a Snezhnayan institution specializing in the development of weapons.

title: Arkhium
content: '''Arkhium''' is a yellow-green crystal that can be used as a potent energy source. The Fontaine Research Institute once tried to harness its power to defy gravity, but research was halted after it caused an explosion that destroyed much of the Institute grounds.

title: Inteyvat
content: The '''Inteyvat''' is the national flower of Khaenri'ah. It is the flower that Lumine wears in her hair. The Traveler also says that they grow in their homeland. It also grows in The Sea of Flowers at the End.

title: Historia Naturalis Liyue
content:
The '''Historia Naturalis Liyue''' is first mentioned by Xiangling in Present From the Past. She recalls that it states that the frozen boar had gone extinct 300 years ago.

The records also mention that all the adepti loved eating Grilled Tiger Fish a thousand years ago.

It also contains an entry that claims that "The Horsetail is a medicinal herb that stands alone on the banks of Dihua Marsh. Its color is that of the clouds at sunset." Grinding this herb into a powder and mixing it into your ink makes the writing water-resistant. However, this variant of the Horsetail may now be extinct.

title: Primordial Sea
content:
The '''Primordial Sea''' is a sea located under Fontaine. It once existed on the surface of the planet and is where most life in Teyvat first originated from. One large passage connecting the Primordial Sea to the surface is located beneath the Fortress of Meropide, but smaller passages and pools of Primordial Seawater can also be found in other underground areas, The Heavenly Principles decreed a prophecy stating that, one day, the water levels in Fontaine will rise and dissolve the people of Fontaine to absolve them of their sin, leaving only the Hydro Archon alive, weeping on her throne.

Following Neuvillette's rise to full dragonhood, he gained his predecessor's control over the Primordial Sea. He used it to "forgive" all Fontainians of their original sin, using the life-giving properties of the Primordial Sea to turn the Fontainians into true humans. Nowadays, the Primordial Sea is no longer a threat to Fontainians.

title: Symbols in Teyvat
content:
The following '''symbols in Teyvat''' are prominent icons, motifs, and symbols that recur throughout the world of Teyvat.

In some cases, they predate the seven nations and are used to represent the ancient civilizations that predate the rise of The Seven.

title: Aether and Lumine's Spaceship
content: '''Aether and Lumine's spaceship''' is the vehicle that the Traveler and their sibling boarded when they were traveling between worlds before arriving on Teyvat. It originally landed in Nod-Krai over five hundred years ago, but has since been moved to the surface of the Frost Moon by the Heavenly Principles following the events of the Cataclysm.

title: Gnosis
content:
A '''Gnosis''', plural '''Gnoses''', is an item used by The Seven to directly resonate with Celestia, and is proof of an Archon's status as one of The Seven. They take on the appearance of chess pieces.

It is implied that the Gnoses were rewarded to the gods who emerged victorious from the Archon War.

title: Immernachtreich
content:
The '''Immernachtreich'''  is a fictional world and the final destination of the universe in the novel series ''Flowers for Princess Fischl'', written by Mr. Nine. This series serves as the basis of Fischl's persona.

Her vision of the Immernachtreich is reflected on the Twinning Isle Mirage during ''Summertime Odyssey'' and in Fischl's Mirage domains during Immernachtreich Apokalypse, which narrate the story of ''Hymn of the Holy Land''.

This page encompasses the lore in ''Flowers for Princess Fischl'' as well as its depiction in ''Hymn of the Holy Land'', which is a reflection of Fischl's subconsciousness.

title: Jade Steel
content: '''Jade Steel''' is a special material from Inazuma used by artisans to forge swords and weapons. It is said to make the swords sharper and tougher, making Inazuman weapons among the best in the world.

title: Sal Terrae (Civilization)
content: '''Sal Terrae''' was the name of a civilization ruled by Havria. It can be explored in Zhongli's Story Quest, in the domain Of Mysteries and Salt.

title: Descender
content:
"'''Descender'''" is a term used by various figures in ''Genshin Impact'' for individuals who are capable of transcending Teyvat's "laws" and influencing its fate. The term is typically used for outlanders from the sea of stars, though it is hypothesized by Rene that it may be possible for entities native to Teyvat to become Descenders as well.

The Traveler is known as the Fourth Descender, and Phanes also known as the Heavenly Principles is known as the First Descender.

title: Isshin Art
content:
The '''Isshin Art''' was one of the five schools in the Raiden Gokaden, Inazuma's five most renowned bladesmithing practices. The Isshin Art had three main clans: the Kaedehara Clan, Niwa Clan, and Akame School.

The Isshin Art was one of only two schools to survive Scaramouche's attempt to destroy the Raiden Gokaden, alongside the Amenoma Art, albeit barely. Following an incident known as the Case of the Eccentric, the Isshin Art's influence was all but ruined, although the Kaedehara Clan still survives through Kaedehara Kazuha.

title: Exorcist
content: '''Exorcists''', also known as '''thaumaturges''', are people in Liyue who have sworn an oath to cleanse the land by hunting down ghosts, spirits and demons. They are highly adept in combat, magic, and martial arts. Most exorcists are raised in families which practice the art as the family trade, although so far only one such group has been named: the Tianheng Thaumaturges.

title: Akasha System
content:
The '''Akasha System''', usually shortened simply to the '''Akasha''', was developed by Greater Lord Rukkhadevata by using her Gnosis and expanded on by Sumeru Akademiya after her death. It allows for the transfer and sharing of information via a device called the '''Akasha Terminal'''.

Following the events of Chapter III, the Akasha System has been shut down, and the Dendro Gnosis handed over to the Fatui.

title: Gurabad
content:
'''Gurabad''', also known as the '''city of brass''' and '''City of Kings''', was an ancient city located in the southwestern part of the Desert of Hadramaveth in Sumeru. It arose after Nabu Malikata's death and fell before King Deshret's forbidden knowledge incident.

It was led by Ormazd before his murder via Liloupar's machinations, after which it was ruled by Parvezravan. Parvezravan himself was later killed by his son, Shiruyeh, and Liloupar's usage of Abyssal power caused most of the city to fall into a deep chasm while a plague claimed the lives of most of the city's population. Afterwards, the city was abandoned and the few attempts to revive its former glory ended in ultimate failure.

Its ruins still lie in the desert, where a massive Ruin Golem (similar to the one found in Devantaka Mountain) is located. Sumeru Akademiya conducted an expedition to Gurabad in the distant past, which was mentioned in some of Zandik's notes.

title: Frost Moon
content: The '''Frost Moon''' is one of the Three Moons of Teyvat.

title: Jinni
content: The '''Jinn''' (singular: '''Jinni''') are a mystical race of elemental spirits that were created by Nabu Malikata.  After the goddess's death, they turned to serve King Deshret. Besides bottles, Jinn are also stated to indwell items such as weapons.

title: Karma
content: '''Karma''', also referred to as '''karmic debt''' and '''divine karma''', is a term which refers to the corruptive forces left behind by the wills and powers of slain ancient gods. This term is primarily used in Liyue, where the yakshas were tasked with subduing the resurging might of fallen gods.

title: Allogravity-Condensed Water Body
content:
'''Allogravity-Condensed Water Bodies''' are structures of water floating hundreds of meters above ground. They are a result of the large explosion that occurred at the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering below them.

Players are able to enter these floating water bodies from all angles and dive inside them. If the player nears the edge of the water body, a warning message will appear saying ''Approaching the edge of the "Allogravity-Condensed Water Body."''

During the later stages of the , several of them will be tainted by Arkhium reactor condensing components, turning them into dangerous '''Transformed Allogravity-Condensed Water Bodies''', discernible by their purple-hued water. However, they will immediately return to their harmless variant after each component has been removed from it.

title: Four Shades
content: The '''Four Shades''', also known as the '''Four Great Rulers''', or '''Archangels''', are four gods who serve directly under the Heavenly Principles as their envoys and emissaries. They were created by the Heavenly Principles following their descent to Teyvat, serving as the personifications, rulers and avatars of the eternal laws.

title: Reed Miller
content:
In Nod-Krai popular folklore, '''Reed Miller''' is the name of the Treasure Hoarders' founder and an infamous Master Thief. In truth, this was an alias used by at least three people, each contributing to the legend of the legendary thief:
* Avrelian, the original Reed Miller.
* Alia, the second Reed Miller.
* Brahe, the third Reed Miller.

title: Anahitian Blessing
content:
'''Anahitian Blessing''' is a type of fertilizer that is said to be a blessing by the Dendro Archon.

In Sumeru City, it is distributed by the Akademiya to farmers for free, as long as they are on a certain list. Details about the distribution are written in the Akasha System.

Vahid sells it at the Syavushi Bakshesh Shoppe in Ritou, Inazuma, though he doesn't have much luck besides a few repeated customers such as Konda Densuke.

title: Oni
content:
are a kind of youkai in Inazuma. According to Shiki Taishou, the oni clans value their principles and pride very much.

Since the events of the cataclysm, the blood of the oni has diluted with each passing day.

title: Eight Adepts
content:
The '''Eight Adepts''' lived in Liyue around the time of the Archon War. They were said to have had adeptus-like abilities, despite not being actual adepti.

During the Archon War, they worked together to subdue the god Tao Dou when he disrupted the boundary between life and death. To do so, they used the Seven-and-Eight-Gates Method, which cost the life of one of their members, the Lone Butterfly of the Crimson Flame.

title: Jibashiri
content: The  were the law enforcement officers of Enkanomiya.

title: Tulaytullah
content:
'''Tulaytullah''', the City of Sapphire, was an ancient city-state in the Hypostyle Desert, Great Red Sand, Sumeru. Its prominence in history began with the priest Hermanubis, who established the original Temple of Silence there and led it to become known as a city of wisdom. However, the subsequent wars between city-states and Eremite tribes after the collapse of King Deshret's civilization caused the members of the Temple of Silence to abandon Tulaytullah. With their departure, Tulaytullah was drawn into the violence; it eventually reached dominance through military conquest, but this soon led to its own downfall.

It was located at what is now the Garden of Endless Pillars.

title: Light Realm
content: The '''Light Realm''', also known as the '''realm of the elements''' and the '''Vishap Realm''', is one of three realms in the world of Teyvat. The Light Realm is host to creatures that harness the pure, raw, primordial elements, also commonly known as elemental beings. It is diametrically opposed to the Void Realm and also incompatible with the Human Realm without adjustments being made to increase compatibility.

title: Fontaine
content:
'''Fontaine''' is one of the seven nations of Teyvat and one of the major regions in ''Genshin Impact''. It is the nation that worshipped Focalors, the Hydro Archon and God of Justice.

Archon Quest Chapter IV takes place in this region.

title: Contending Fire
content:
'''Contending Fire''' is a form of energy produced in battle between the people of Natlan. It is crucial for Natlan's survival, as it is the fuel that sustains the Sacred Flame. Contending Fire is primarily generated through the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame, a combat-focused tournament.

Objects carried in battle by warriors of Natlan can also become imbued with Contending Fire. Burning these objects can "activate" the Contending Fire they contain and allow it to be used as fuel, as shown by Mavuika in the quest ''Past and Future''.

title: Ninken
content: are dogs who are or were associated with and trained under the Shuumatsuban. They have heightened senses, intelligence, and ninja training, and are capable of using ninjutsu.

title: False Sky
content: The '''false sky''' (also referred to as the '''firmament''') is a physical barrier that envelops the planet of Teyvat. It was created by the Heavenly Principles for the purpose of separating the world from the sea of stars, and to hide it from the rest of the universe. Its true nature is obscured from the inside by a visual projection of an ordinary sky. Proof of the existence of the false sky has appeared on several occasions in the form of ruptures referred to as "split-sky phenomena."

title: Vision Hunt Ceremony
content:
The '''Vision Hunt Ceremony''' was an event led by the Electro Archon during  to mark the 100th Vision taken under her Vision Hunt Decree. She intended to take Thoma's Pyro Vision during the ceremony, but was interrupted by the Traveler, who retrieved Thoma's Vision and escaped after a fight with the Shogun.

The events of this ceremony caused the Tenryou Commission to add the Traveler to their wanted list. After the ceremony, Thoma went into hiding in the Komore Teahouse and the Traveler joined the Watatsumi Army.

title: Ancient Name
content:
An '''Ancient Name''' (or '''tocaitl''') is a title borne by certain members of the six tribes of Natlan, as well as a special obsidian stone representative of the title. 

Each Ancient Name is typically associated with a desirable attribute, such as "resilience" or "leader," which the chosen recipient will embody. An Ancient Name is also associated with the heroic deeds of all its previous bearers, and thus, the passing down of Ancient Names is a way of preserving the tribe's history and culture.

title: Yumekui-Baku
content: , also known simply as '''baku''', are a kind of youkai in Inazuma.

title: Yougou Tengu
content: The  are a group of tengu related to Mt. Yougou. They created the Empty Boat of a Thousand Gates at the end of the Araumi underground labyrinth, which housed the "Yougou Three," who trained under them.

title: Snezhnaya
content:
is one of the seven nations of Teyvat and one of the major regions in ''Genshin Impact''. It is the nation that worships the Tsaritsa, the Cryo Archon. The Fatui, a military force under her control, is particularly notorious for their diehard devotion and their unscrupulous methods in enacting her will. The autonomous region Nod-Krai is located at the southernmost part of Snezhnaya.

Archon Quest Chapter VI takes place in this region.

title: Ghost
content: '''Ghosts''' are spectral NPCs that appear throughout the game.

title: Dodocommunication Device
content:
The '''Dodocommunication Device''' is a magical device that the Traveler encounters during Summertime Odyssey.

Created by Alice, the device was originally gifted to Venti from whom another copy was given to the Traveler. The device served as the Traveler and Venti's communication channel throughout the event Story Quest.

title: Ochkanatlan Adventure Team
content: The '''Ochkanatlan Adventure Team''' ''(unofficial name)'' was a group of adventurers who journeyed to Ochkanatlan around the time of the Cataclysm in search of the treasure of the Tonatiuh, which was rumored to be able to repel the Abyss. Only one member, the young mystic Liriwu, returned alive.

title: Project Stuzha
content:
'''Project Stuzha''' is a project conducted by the Eleven Fatui Harbingers. It is known to involve Arlecchino, Tartaglia, Pulcinella, Pantalone, and Pierro.

Very little is currently known about Project Stuzha. Following the events of Fontaine's Archon Quests, Pantalone and Pulcinella decided to place Arlecchino and the House of the Hearth at the forefront of the project. However, she and her members suspect this is a ploy to keep their growing influence in check. They are prepared for this, intending to catch Pulcinella and Pantalone off guard after removing their "weakest" members to avoid being exploited. According to Mikhail, the project is being led directly by Pierro and Pulcinella.

According to Columbina, the term "'''Mistilteinn'''" appears to be connected to Project Stuzha. Additionally, the project expended a lot of resources, leaving the city of Snezhnograd low on supplies.

title: Umibouzu
content: are a mentioned species of sea creature in Inazuma.

title: Abyss
content: The '''Abyss''', also known as the '''Void Realm''', is a dark destructive force that originates from the Sea of stars. It was introduced into Teyvat by Nibelung during the war of funerary flame. The Abyss has a great adaptive capability, and commonly manifests in the form of Abyssal monsters or as corruptive energy.

title: Ode of Resurrection
content: The '''Ode of Resurrection''' (also called the '''Rite of Resurrection''') is a ceremony performed in Natlan at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame to resurrect Ancient Name bearers who have died while fighting the Abyss in the Night Warden Wars. To be resurrected, the person must have "achieved victory," meaning that at least one member of their group came back victorious. The healing powers of the Ode only apply to fatal injuries, and will not heal previous injuries acquired during the battle or pre-existing ailments.
